name: Pigment Liner Fineliner Pack, Black, 3 Pens (0.05, 0.2 and 0.8 mm)
bestUse: Best for captions, dates and fine details
descriptionOriginal: Three black pigment-ink fineliners in a fine, a medium and a broad tip.
whyWeLikeIt: Three widths cover fine captions, everyday writing and bolder outlines, so a beginner gets the useful range without buying a big box. Staedtler describes the ink as waterproof on paper.
limitations: Black only, so this is not a colour set. Waterproof is the maker's claim for writing on paper; try it on a glossy sticker before committing a page.
